{"page":1,"quote":"At the UNFCCC COP26 in November 2021, the governments of South Africa and France, Germany, the United Kingdom, the United States of America, and the European Union (the International Partners Group - IPG) announced a new ambitious, long-term Just Energy Transition Partnership ( JETP ).","label":"announced a new ambitious, long-term Just Energy Transition Partnership","classification":"event","fields":{"amount":null,"date":"November 2021","funder":null,"implementer":"the governments of South Africa and France, Germany, the United Kingdom, the United States of America, and the European Union","speaker":null},"other":[]},
{"page":1,"quote":"In line with the Political Declaration issued in November 2021, the IPG undertook to mobilise an initial amount of $8.5 billion over the next 3 to 5 years to advance the JETP .","label":"undertook to mobilise an initial amount of $8.5 billion","classification":"target","fields":{"amount":"$8.5 billion","date":"over the next 3 to 5 years","funder":"IPG","implementer":null,"speaker":null},"other":[]},
